name: Workshop Needs Observatory
actions: scan declaration drift from UI or CLI without mutating modules
show missing substrates contracts and hands
show current module-review candidates without promoting them
match a quarantined piece to a need
summary: One honest page for what the Workshop and its AI collaborators need, what already exists, and which reviewed piece or evidence-backed module is waiting for an explicit human decision.
notes: Exact declared capabilities only. Review readiness is evidence for inspection, never approval, promotion, CANON status, authority, or automatic need closure.
